purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) processing system — data-check error patient information registration subprogram
purpose.summary: This subprogram (ORCDTCHK010) is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt software. It performs data-check processing by deleting prior error information from the check master table (tbl_chk004) and then registering new error patient information. It is called with job management parameters and operates on indexed files and a database via MCP calls.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with multiple USING parameters (subprogram interface)
18 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (CPJOBKANRI, CPCHK004, MCPDATA, etc.)
12 CALL statements including ORCSGETTEMP, ORCSJOBKANRI, ORCSMCNDATE
Database access via MCP interface (MCPDATA/MCPAREA pattern, tbl_chk004)
Japanese text in comments and literals (EUC-JP / latin-1 decoded)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP DB layer
PERFORM UNTIL nested loops for error patient record processing
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comments and Japanese string literals. Content is clearly production ORCA medical receipt system code. Truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible to classify confidently.
